props.text: We are a team of doctors, nurses and therapists who have looked after families in this.
Doctors, nurses and therapists who know your family, with same-day appointments for urgent care.
Check-ups, chronic care and everyday illness.
Screening, pregnancy care and family planning.
Care for every stage of family life
We are a team of doctors, nurses and therapists who have looked after families in this community for over twenty years.
Appointments run on time, results are explained in plain language, and you can always reach a nurse by phone.
Choose a time online or call us. Urgent cases are seen the same day.

props.question: Can I get my results by phone?
props.answer: Yes. A nurse will call you and explain them.

props.question: Do I need an appointment?
props.answer: Appointments are best, but we see urgent cases the same day.

props.question: Which insurance do you accept?
props.answer: All major medical aid schemes, and we explain fees before treatment.

props.question: Are you open at weekends?
props.answer: Yes, every day from 7 am. Sundays until 1 pm.
